page: The OVHcloud t2-le-90 is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance within the Cloud GPU family, provisioned using the KVM hypervisor on the x86_64 architecture. Compute is driven by a dedicated Intel Xeon 6226R processor operating at a base clock of 2.9 GHz across 30 dedicated physical cores without hyperthreading. System memory is configured at 90 GB of RAM, offering 3.0 GB per core. The instance includes local storage consisting of a 500 GB NVMe SSD and features a baseline network throughput of 4 Gbps, without complimentary public IPv4 addresses included.

Hardware acceleration is delivered by two NVIDIA Volta V100S GPUs providing an aggregate of 64 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. Benchmark results reflect the architectural focus on machine learning workloads, with LLM inference tests registering top-tier performance percentiles across 7B and 70B parameter models for both prompt processing and token generation. Multi-threaded decompression tasks via bzip3 and PassMark memory metrics also demonstrate strong results within the top 25% of measured systems, whereas general CPU benchmarks such as Geekbench single-core (1245.0) and multi-core (10696.0) sit squarely in the median range.

In terms of qualitative efficiency, the instance provides high GPU compute density and memory capacity suited for machine learning models that can leverage dual Volta accelerators, offsetting the moderate single-thread CPU performance and modest 4 Gbps networking. The bundled 500 GB NVMe SSD provides local high-speed caching and artifact storage. Primary workload targets include deep learning inference, distributed machine learning model serving, computational data science pipelines, and vector-accelerated scientific computing.
description: OVHcloud t2-le-90 is a GPU-focused cloud instance engineered for machine learning and parallel processing tasks. Based on the x86_64 architecture running under KVM, it features 30 dedicated cores from an Intel Xeon 6226R processor clocked at 2.9 GHz, paired with 90 GB of system memory. Graphics acceleration is powered by dual NVIDIA Volta V100S GPUs delivering 64 GB of aggregate VRAM. Storage consists of a local 500 GB NVMe SSD, complemented by a 4 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark results indicate top-tier throughput in large language model inference workloads across small, medium, and 70B parameter models, alongside strong multi-threaded decompression and memory performance. While general-purpose CPU scores remain average, the server provides substantial compute density for deep learning inference, machine learning model evaluation, and accelerated scientific computing pipelines.
